summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtins feature, uncommitted. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) with the 11 members from the spec, plus the enum import. botocore/args.py adds the EPRBuiltins import, makes the STS predicate accept an absent endpoint config (treated as no variant tags), and adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean. tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (derives from unittest.TestCase) with one test per acceptance criterion. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py passes 59/59. Full tests/unit run gives 3142 passed and 11 failed; the same 11 fail on clean HEAD (9 in test_awsrequest.py, plus test_session.py and test_session_legacy.py test_internal_component), so they are pre-existing and unrelated. Line length: all added lines are within 79 columns; botocore/args.py:315 (83 cols) is pre-existing. black and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting and import order were checked by hand, not by tool. Caveat: the helper calls bridge private methods _resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint, as the spec requires reuse of those lookups.
